rows.name: Bachelor of Business Administration with Honours
rows.source_title: NUS Bulletin AY2025/26 - School of Business Undergraduate Education
rows.evidence_snippet: NUS Business School offers BBA (Hons), BBA Accountancy (Hons), and BBA Real Estate (Hons); the BBA curriculum lists 9 majors including Accountancy, Applied Business Analytics, Business Economics, Finance, Innovation and Entrepreneurship, Leadership and Human Capital Management, Marketing, Operations and Supply Chain Management, and Real Estate.

rows.name: Bachelor of Computing in Computer Science
rows.degree_or_award: Bachelor of Computing (Honours) in Computer Science
rows.source_title: NUS Bulletin AY2025/26 - School of Computing Undergraduate Education
rows.evidence_snippet: School of Computing degrees offered include Bachelor of Computing in Computer Science, Information Security, Business Artificial Intelligence Systems, Artificial Intelligence, Bachelor of Science in Business Analytics, and jointly Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Engineering; programmes are four-year undergraduate programmes.

rows.name: Bachelor of Engineering (Mechanical Engineering)
rows.source_title: NUS Bulletin AY2025/26 - College of Design and Engineering Undergraduate Education
rows.evidence_snippet: CDE Bachelor's Degree Programmes list includes Architecture, Industrial Design, multiple Engineering majors, Robotics and Machine Intelligence, and Landscape Architecture; degree requirements for cohorts 2025/26 onwards describe a 160-unit curriculum.
